title: Delivery and appointment interactions
summary: This topic mostly contains ambiguous notes about customer interactions during delivery, calls, or RVG appointments, with one clear complaint that the delivery session did not provide enough time to absorb the vehicle’s features.

negative.summary: The negative feedback says the vehicle’s many features and settings were overwhelming to cover in a single delivery session.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined fragments are brief context notes about timing, customer questions during RVG appointments, delivery orientation, or calls without enough information to judge sentiment.

limitations: Most fragments are undetermined and too brief to support strong conclusions about customer sentiment.
The cluster mixes several interaction contexts, including delivery sessions, RVG appointments, ownership timing notes, and live calls, rather than one clearly unified issue.
Examples are insufficient to characterize sentiment beyond the single clear negative complaint.
